moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday today, continuing her reign on the global charts.

angles.name: Pop Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa! From 'New Rules' to 'Houdini', she just keeps delivering the bangers. What's your favourite Dua track?

angles.name: Dance Floor Diva
angles.copy: 31 years young today, Dua Lipa! Her tracks are essential for any dance playlist. Which one gets you moving every time?

moments.title: Premier League Matchday 1 continues
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off its first full Saturday of action today with five matches, including Hull City vs Man Utd and Brentford vs Tottenham.

angles.name: Saturday Football Buzz
angles.copy: Premier League is BACK with a bang! Full schedule of games today including Hull City vs Man Utd and Brentford vs Tottenham. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Weekend Kick-Off
angles.copy: It's Matchday 1 in the Premier League! Hull City, Ipswich Town, Nottingham Forest, Everton and Brentford all in action today. Get your predictions in!

moments.title: Premier League Matchday 1 continues Sunday
moments.blurb: Matchday 1 of the Premier League season continues tomorrow, Sunday August 23rd, with Brighton vs Aston Villa, Man City vs Bournemouth and Newcastle vs Liverpool.

angles.name: Sunday Showdowns
angles.copy: Big clashes tomorrow in the Premier League! Man City host Bournemouth, and Liverpool travel to Newcastle. What are your Sunday score predictions?

angles.name: Weekend Wrap-Up
angles.copy: Wrapping up the opening weekend of the Premier League tomorrow! Brighton vs Aston Villa also on the cards. Who will grab those early points?

moments.title: Creamfields 2026 kicks off
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest electronic dance music festival, Creamfields, takes over Daresbury, Cheshire from Thursday, August 27th to Sunday, August 30th.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Creamfields 2026 is just days away! Daresbury is about to become the UK's dance capital. Who's heading there for a huge weekend?

angles.name: DJs Descend
angles.copy: Get ready for four days of non-stop beats! Creamfields brings the world's biggest DJs to Cheshire this Bank Holiday weekend. What set are you most hyped for?

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61
moments.blurb: The 'Queen of Country Pop', Shania Twain, will celebrate her 61st birthday on Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Country Pop Royalty
angles.copy: Happy almost birthday to the one and only Shania Twain! Turning 61 on Thursday, her hits are still 'That Don't Impress Me Much'... said no one ever! What's your favourite?

angles.name: Iconic Anthems
angles.copy: From 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' to 'From This Moment On', Shania Twain's anthems are timeless. Celebrating her 61st birthday this week!

moments.title: Florence Welch turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the enigmatic lead singer of Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Indie Icon's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy 40th Birthday to the incredible Florence Welch this Thursday! The voice of Florence + The Machine, always captivating. What's your top track?

angles.name: Lyrical Genius
angles.copy: Celebrating Florence Welch's 40th this week! Her songwriting and powerful vocals make Florence + The Machine truly unique. Which song resonates most with you?

moments.title: UK Summer Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: Three-day weekend incoming! The Summer Bank Holiday is this Monday, August 31st. How are you making the most of the extra day off?

angles.name: End of Summer
angles.copy: It's the last Bank Holiday of summer this Monday! What are your plans for the long weekend before autumn officially rolls in?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 launch
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing will return with its pre-recorded launch show airing on Saturday, September 19th, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly Returns
angles.copy: Get ready for glitter and glamour! Strictly Come Dancing is back with a new look this September, featuring Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe. Who are you excited to see hit the dance floor?

angles.name: New Hosts Alert
angles.copy: Strictly Come Dancing has a brand new hosting trio for 2026! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe & Johannes Radebe are taking the reins. Thoughts on the shake-up?

moments.title: Beyoncé turns 45
moments.blurb: Global icon Beyoncé Giselle Knowles-Carter will celebrate her 45th birthday on Friday, September 4th.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Birthday
angles.copy: A huge birthday coming up for Queen Bey! Beyoncé turns 45 on September 4th. What's the ultimate Beyoncé track for you?

angles.name: Iconic Performer
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring impact of Beyoncé as her 45th birthday approaches! From Destiny's Child to solo superstardom, she's a true legend. What's your favourite era?
